name: price_level
meaning: Raw closing price; large-price stocks score high.

name: price_rank
meaning: Cross-sectional rank of the closing price.

name: reversal_5d
meaning: Distance of price from its 5-day average; short-term reversal.

name: deviation_20d
meaning: Distance of price from its 20-day average.

name: zscore_20d
meaning: 20-day z-score of price: deviation scaled by recent volatility.

name: zscore_20d_rank
meaning: Cross-sectional rank of the 20-day price z-score.

name: relative_range
meaning: Daily high-low range as a fraction of price; a volatility measure.

name: relative_volume_rank
meaning: Rank of today's volume against its 20-day average.

name: price_to_ma20
meaning: Price relative to its 20-day moving average.

name: trend_60d
meaning: Percentage distance from the 60-day average; medium-term trend.

name: price_cv_20d
meaning: Coefficient of variation of price over 20 days; relative volatility.

name: intraday_strength
meaning: Open-to-close move as a share of the day's range (Alpha101 #101).

name: volume_surprise
meaning: Percentage by which today's volume exceeds its 20-day average.

name: signed_volume
meaning: Relative volume signed by the day's direction; buying or selling pressure.

name: stochastic_20d
meaning: Where the close sits in the 20-day high-low channel (stochastic %K).

name: drawdown_20d
meaning: Percentage below the 20-day high.

name: ma_ratio_5_60
meaning: Short against long moving average; trend-following signal.

name: ma_crossover_10_40
meaning: Difference between 10-day and 40-day moving averages.

name: momentum_proxy_120d
meaning: Recent month average against the half-year average; momentum.

name: zscore_252d
meaning: One-year z-score of price; long-horizon mean reversion.

name: range_volatility_20d
meaning: Variability of the daily range, scaled by price.

name: average_range_20d
meaning: Average relative daily range over 20 days.

name: intraday_volatility_20d
meaning: Volatility of open-to-close returns over 20 days.

name: intraday_reversal_5d
meaning: Average open-to-close return over 5 days; short-term reversal.

name: liquidity_20d
meaning: Log of average volume; a liquidity and size proxy.

name: volume_rank
meaning: Cross-sectional rank of traded volume.

name: volume_cv_20d
meaning: How erratic volume has been over 20 days.

name: volume_trend_5_60
meaning: Recent volume against the quarter's average; rising interest.

name: volume_weighted_move
meaning: Intraday return weighted by relative volume.

name: upper_shadow
meaning: Gap between the high and the close as a share of range; selling pressure.

name: close_location
meaning: Where the close sits inside the day's range.

name: channel_width_60d
meaning: Width of the 60-day high-low channel relative to price.

name: above_252d_low
meaning: Percentage above the one-year low.

name: zscore_5d_rank
meaning: Rank of the 5-day price z-score; short-term overreaction.

name: volume_price_divergence
meaning: Volume rank minus price-trend rank; volume not confirmed by price.

name: up_day_share_10d
meaning: Net share of up days over the last 10 days.
